canonical_project: NIC National Data Centre, Shastri Park
notes: NIC Delhi says NIC has set up National Data Centres at Delhi/Pune/Hyderabad; Government webcast archived the 17-Dec-2012 inauguration of National Data Centre at Shastri Park, New Delhi. A 2025 GeM buyer document for NDCSP says the facility was established in 2011 and has around 475 racks hosting National Cloud and government applications; MW capacity not disclosed.
